dot.derivation: Legacy single-dot tile retained only as the before-image comparator; it is no longer used by the generated client.

error.derivation: SVG exports combined at their original relative positions, centered within an 18px viewBox. Root fill=none preserves the source circle interior; only the explicit exclamation rectangles are filled. Chromium alpha checks cover the ring, four transparent interior points, stem, dot and gap.

stopped.derivation: SVG exports combined at their original relative positions, centered within an 18px viewBox. Root fill=none preserves the source circle interior; only the explicit central stop square is filled. Chromium alpha checks cover the ring, four transparent interior points and central square.

dotFields.geometry: Every original closed path is retained with its original SVG origin. Repeated local paths are deduplicated after rounding relative coordinates to 0.001px; no substitute circles are drawn. Original vector paint alpha is read directly because MCP SVG output rounds values below 0.01.

light-wide.method: Chromium rasterization of full Figma SVG; fill-opacity restored from original vector alpha in source child order.

implementationChoices.motionMeaning: Seven active animation seconds per loop is an implementation parameter, not measured Figma timing. The independent source-derived point layer flows upper-left by five grid columns and one row; corresponding lattice points blend to the same source field at the cycle boundary, with no whole-card opacity wave. Source-derived alpha interpolation keeps the lower readability fade spatially stable. Foreground remains fixed.
implementationChoices.terminalRecords: Existing bounded canonical public events are redacted before retention in memory. Normal artifact persistence still omits the raw event stream; no transcript persistence was added.
implementationChoices.dotTemplate: Supersedes the legacy repeated first-dot tile. Three complete source geometries and their distinct Light/Dark paints are used. At the measured 620×300, 240×620 and 360×200 sizes, phase zero preserves source origin, local path and exact vector alpha. At other dimensions the original dot shapes and grid spacing remain fixed while source rows/columns are sampled across the available frame.

motionReference.notes: Source A/B use the same full SVG texture with different offsets; direction is illustrative. Static examples do not define speed, duration or amplitude.

implementationChoices.stoppedMotion: waiting/stopping/stopped/error/paused are static; a running task freezes its current phase on stop and resumes that phase on retry. prefers-reduced-motion renders source phase zero with no RAF loop.

verification.scope: All six source-sized fields, actual ResearchCanvas state/hover/manual-box tests, deterministic full-loop pixels and real-time independent dot-field video. Packaged-client validation is performed separately by the integrating task.
